title: Immigration Visa (Historical)

origin.publisher: U.S. Department of State, American Consular Service (Riga, Latvia); image hosted on the RootsWeb wiki
origin.title: Quota Immigration Visa No. 840, issued at Riga, Latvia, February 2, 1927
origin.clearance_note: A 1927 United States quota immigration visa issued by the American Consular Service at Riga under the Immigration Act of 1924, on a Government Printing Office form: a record of the US federal government, and of the kind held in the USCIS Visa Files series (July 1, 1924 - March 31, 1944). The image is hosted on the RootsWeb genealogy wiki (Ancestry); its file-description page refused scripted access (HTTP 403), so the uploader and any further attribution could not be checked, and RootsWeb is recorded as the host rather than the publisher. The operator downloaded the 600x820 JPEG by hand on 2026-11-16; it was wrapped in a one-page PDF with no metadata. Published as printed, including the bearer's name and photograph, under the historical-record exemption. Evidence: the visa is dated February 2nd, 1927 on its face, more than 72 years ago, and the bearer is photographed as an elderly woman at that date. The vice consul signs in an official role.

notes: No feature page or fields were requested. The overlay shows the visa as an instrument of the 1924 quota system: its number, the consulate that issued it, the preference box checked, the national quota it was charged to, and the act it was granted under. No individual is featured, though the bearer's name and photograph are on the page. fee ($9.00) is extracted correctly but grounds to the parse's description of the photograph rather than to the fee line, so it is not featured. The dates ground OFF only because the schema normalizes them to YYYY-MM-DD.
